name: Harbor Roast
purpose: Online store for a small-batch coffee roaster — browse products with photos and prices, cart, guest checkout, and past-order history.
actors: Guest shopper — browses and buys without an account
Customer — sees past orders via signed receipt link or account
Roaster admin — manages products and fulfills orders

entities.name: Product
relationships: has many orders through order items

workflows.name: Browse products
workflows.description: Catalog grid with photos and prices; product page with roast level and origin

workflows.name: Add to cart and adjust quantities
workflows.description: Cart with quantity controls and running total

workflows.name: Checkout as a guest
workflows.description: Collects email and shipping address, completes via demo payment simulator, shows receipt

workflows.name: View past orders
workflows.description: Signed expiring link shows order history; signed-in customers see theirs in-app

workflows.name: Admin: manage catalog and orders
workflows.description: Madmin dashboard to add/edit products and update order status

seed_demo: Six Harbor Roast coffee products with photos, prices, roast levels, origins and tasting notes, plus a sample fulfilled order for order history.
